register.title: Daniil Ostashev's three composition packings at a8db6ff, issue528
register.headline: New packings of 175, 232 and 264 squares, each composed with a new 38-square rectangle and certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that each packing passes its own C++ checker (sqverify --precise --certify, MPFR then GMP rationals) at delta = 1e-60, that sqverify --check-cert certifies the shipped certificates in GMP rationals with no dilation and no tolerance, and that a separately written 80-digit mpmath cross-check finds a least separation of 5.0e-21; the issue states that all three checkers are the author's, written with AI assistance, the first two sharing the C++ parser and geometry. It also states that each side is the exact first-order optimum of its contact topology, with nonnegative KKT multipliers at a 60-digit solution and the load-bearing squares scaled by 1 + 1e-20. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Daniil Ostashev (https://github.com/dostashev/square-packing) with the three packings and their certificates, compositions the issue says are new arrangements and not refinements: two library rectangles in opposite corners plus aligned squares, each using the author's new packing of 38 unit squares in an (h + 2) x h rectangle, h = 5.7641743..., found by a GPU soft-to-rigid search after Yohei Nakajima's idea; at 175 with David Ellsworth's s(171) template, whose pieces are cut from Thomas Schadt's s(50), at 232 with a 76-square piece of Erich Friedman's s(85), and at 264 with a 93-square piece of Evan Daniel's exact optimum of Joost de Winter's s(126). The author asks to be credited and leaves the pieces' acknowledgement to the record. The issue states AI assistance: the author set up and drove an AI-assisted research loop with his own ideas, the rectangle library and composition being his; AI agents wrote and ran the search, composition and verification code.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then weigh adoption: each side is below its case's ceiling and below every other report at its count, by 2.95e-03 at 175 (Francisco Couzo's 337078c, not registered, think-9fjl), 3.25e-03 at 232 (T-136) and 3.44e-03 at 264 (the catalogue's 9 + 11 sqrt(2)/2, which the issue calls Goebel's pattern, T-101). Then record source-specific adoption and confirming evidence. Final exact-head CI remains required.
